errors.evidence: The description omits the context provided in the chart's title, '继续预训练Loss下降图' (Continued Pre-training Loss Decrease Chart). It only provides a generic description of what the chart shows ('the change in Loss value during the Step process').
At Step 10, the Loss value is visibly higher than 1.2. The line passes through y=2 at approximately Step 5, and at Step 10 it is still well above 1.2, likely around 1.5-1.8.
The x-axis labels go up to 250, but the data line extends beyond this point to approximately Step 275. Therefore, the actual range of the data is greater than 0 to 250.
This statement contains two errors. First, Step 250 is not the endpoint of the data. Second, the Loss value at Step 250 is approximately 0.3, not 0.2. The value 0.2 is an underestimate by about 33%.
